LESSON: CONNECTED TEXT AND FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Connected text and fluency

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Connected text and fluency. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

You will learn the key ideas about Connected text and fluency and use them at home and at school.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Read about Connected text and fluency with your parent or teacher. Say what it means in your own words.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Connected text and fluency.
2. Explain Connected text and fluency to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners read individually in the library 2) What do you love requiring more accuracy and about 200 words under the guidance of the teacher reading? expression at intervals of two weeks. transitioning
4. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Connected text and fluency. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when reading?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
